mil3.3.8:1.2: “Venerable Nāgasena, where mind consciousness arises, do contact and feeling also arise there?”
mil3.3.8:1.3: “Yes, Great King, where mind consciousness arises, contact also arises there, feeling also arises there, perception also arises there, intention also arises there, placing the mind also arises there, keeping it connected also arises there; all the phenomena headed by contact arise there.”
mil3.3.8:2.1: “Venerable Nāgasena, what is the characteristic of contact?”
mil3.3.8:3.2: “Suppose, Great King, two rams were to fight. Of those, as the first ram, so should the eye be seen.
mil3.3.8:3.3: As the second ram, so should the visible form be seen.
mil3.3.8:3.4: As their coming together, so should contact be seen.”
mil3.3.8:4.2: “Suppose, Great King, two hands were to clap. Of those, as the first hand, so should the eye be seen.
mil3.3.8:4.3: As the second hand, so should the visible form be seen.
mil3.3.8:4.4: As their coming together, so should contact be seen.”
mil3.3.8:5.2: “Suppose, Great King, two cymbals were to sound. Of those, as the first cymbal, so should the eye be seen.
mil3.3.8:5.3: As the second cymbal, so should the visible form be seen.
mil3.3.8:5.4: As their coming together, so should contact be seen.”
